# Use cases

<!-- Generated from the front matter in usecases/*.md by `./run.py gallery usecases-md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

What you can do with RemotiveTopology, shown with the examples in this repository. The
[example gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples) on the developer site has all of them, with pictures and filters.

| Use case | Goal | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| [FMU models](usecases/FMU_MODELS.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/fmu)) | Simulate | Run an exported FMU as the behavior of an ECU |
| [Python behavioral models](usecases/BEHAVIORAL_MODELS.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/python-models)) | Simulate | Model ECUs that don't exist yet, in a few lines of Python |
| [Scenario tests with behave](usecases/TESTCASES_BEHAVE.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/behave)) | Test | Tests written as scenarios that domain experts can read |
| [Test cases with pytest](usecases/TESTCASES_PYTEST.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/pytest)) | Test | Integration tests as Python code, run as part of the topology |
| [Signal playback](usecases/PLAYBACK_SIGNALS.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/signal-playback)) | Replay | Recorded VSS signals, converted by models into platform signals |
| [3D visualization](usecases/3D.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/3d-visualization)) | Visualize | The car reacts to live signals in the browser |
| [Instrument cluster](usecases/INSTRUMENT_CLUSTER.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/instrument-cluster)) | Visualize | A real Qt instrument cluster as the DIM ECU, reading CAN over SocketCAN |
| [Jupyter notebook](usecases/JUPYTER.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/jupyter)) | Visualize | Drive a running topology from a notebook with buttons and plots |
| [Android Cuttlefish](usecases/ANDROID_CUTTLEFISH.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/android-cuttlefish)) | Integrate | A custom Android Automotive build, connected over SOME/IP or VHAL |
| [Android Emulator](usecases/ANDROID_EMULATOR.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/android-emulator)) | Integrate | An Android Automotive app on simulated vehicle signals, on any OS |
| [Traceability with Sphinx-Needs](usecases/TRACEABILITY_SPHINX.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/traceability)) | Process | Requirements traced to ECUs, models and tests, as docs-as-code |

More use cases are in [Topology examples](https://github.com/remotivelabs/remotivelabs-topology-examples/blob/main/USECASES.md).
